name: clk125
description: NI-provided free-running 125 MHz; use this same clock for the SCTL

name: reset_n
description: Active-low reset, hold at least 4 clocks, wait for input_ready after release

name: session_start
description: One clock pulse starts a new continuity epoch

name: session_abort
description: One clock pulse disarms input and discards in-flight state

name: stream_gap
description: One clock pulse declares real sample loss; discard old epoch; valid pause alone is not sample loss

name: input_valid
description: Hold all four IQ words until valid and ready

name: input_ready
description: Accept all four IQ samples on valid and ready

name: input_data0
description: Lane 0, packed Q16 high / I16 low, lane0 is earliest

name: input_data1
description: Lane 1, packed Q16 high / I16 low, lane0 is earliest

name: input_data2
description: Lane 2, packed Q16 high / I16 low, lane0 is earliest

name: input_data3
description: Lane 3, packed Q16 high / I16 low, lane0 is earliest

name: result_valid
description: Entire result bundle remains stable until result_ready

name: result_ready
description: Acknowledge all result fields atomically

name: result_epoch
description: Continuity epoch of this result

name: rx_frame_id
description: Local confirmed frame sequence, starts at zero per epoch; not decoded transmitter frame id

name: candidate_id
description: Internal candidate sequence, including rejected proposals

name: coarse_absolute
description: Coarse position in accepted samples since epoch start

name: fine_absolute
description: Fine position in accepted samples since epoch start

name: cfo_hz
description: Signed coarse CFO Hz; raw payload has not been corrected

name: quality_q1_15
description: Fine timing quality code Q1.15

name: result_status
description: Kind and validity flags; 0x3800 is a valid fine result

name: accepted_samples
description: Live accepted-sample count within current epoch

name: epoch
description: Live continuity epoch

name: candidate_count
description: Eligible plateau proposals

name: rejected_count
description: Candidates rejected by local estimator

name: capture_drop_count
description: Candidates rejected for copy/slot capacity or stale history

name: duplicate_count
description: Queued proposals suppressed near the confirmed frame

name: confirmed_count
description: Confirmed frames admitted to result holding register

name: snapshot_occupancy
description: Number of occupied snapshot slots, 0..2

name: snapshot_peak
description: Maximum snapshot occupancy, 0..2

name: max_history_age
description: Largest oldest-needed-sample age at copy start

name: error_sticky
description: Per-epoch hardware diagnostics; see interface guide
